side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: 32 complete fresh passive accountability clauses, balanced sixteen per typed omission form
manifest.selection: Sixteen wholly fresh event clauses were frozen before tokenizer import and crossed with both omission forms. They span access control, audit, release, storage, failover, compliance, credentials, governance, and recovery. Each English arm is the proposal's complete doer-knowledge mapping with the same event clause.
manifest.method: Compute Ainglish minus English tokens per pair for each tokenizer, average within each omission form, average the two form means equally, and report the maximum tokenizer mean as least-favourable token_delta. Retain every finite outcome.

estimand.population: the 32 complete fresh typed-omission pairs frozen in this manifest
estimand.aggregation: equal form mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: complete careful-English author-knowledge and withholding mapping
estimand.interpretation: token cost of communicating why the doer is unnamed, not marker length versus an untyped passive

manifest.freeze: The API retained the canonical manifest before tokenizer import or token observation.
